description: Post-meeting debrief engine: pull the transcript, detect every signal, write the summary + follow-up email, log the engagement, and triage actions into do-now / send / queued-prompt lanes.

swapPoints.prompt: Where do this client's meeting transcripts come from, and how should I fetch them? (e.g. Otter, Zoom, Fathom, Granola, a shared staging folder, a connected MCP, or 'paste' if they'll always paste manually)
Which CRM should meetings + engagements get logged to? (e.g. HubSpot, Pipedrive, Salesforce, or 'none')
When money is owed, which tool should I create the invoice or payment link in? (e.g. Stripe, QuickBooks, Square, or 'none' to just flag it)
Which calendar should I check and stage invites against? (e.g. Google Calendar, Outlook/Microsoft 365, or 'none')
Where should follow-up email DRAFTS be created? (e.g. Gmail, Outlook/Microsoft 365 — drafts only, never sent)
Where does this client keep per-contact work, and what's the folder pattern? (e.g. 'clients/<name>/ with research/ and conversations/ subfolders') Optional.
Path to the email/voice guide to reuse for follow-up email tone (optional). Leave blank to use the generic professional follow-up voice.
